name: tailscale
summary: Tailscale Funnel through the Tailscale client already signed in on this machine, at its ts.net hostname

notes.name: requirements
notes.text: Needs Tailscale 1.38.3 or later with MagicDNS, HTTPS certificates and the funnel node attribute; on Linux run "sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER" once.

notes.name: first_use
notes.text: The first funnel may print a link to enable it for the tailnet; open it, and the share continues once it is enabled.

notes.name: ports
notes.text: Funnel serves one share per public port: 443, 8443 or 10000.

modes.name: funnel
modes.summary: This machine's ts.net hostname, public through Funnel
